Hi Jeffrey,
I’ve downloaded it yesterday and I liked it for it’s semplicity.
The only thing that I would like to see is a WYSIWYG HTML editor…

Apart that it has all the functionalities that I need…

See you perhaps at the next Tech Ed!!!
Bye!

Lorenzo,
Thanks. It has a WYSIWYG Html editor. When you log in with the “admin” account to start, there is a link “Edit Content”. Click there, and you will see a FreeTextBox instance. This is the “Content Editor” plugin that also allows file and image uploaders.

Hi Jeffrey,
I’ve downloaded your project but at the moment I’ve not tested it (too busy in these days, maybe during the weekend).
A little suggestion (or request): why don’t you launch a test site for a real demo? I think it could be useful for everyone that want to try the tool.
Keep up the great work, when I’ll test it you’ll receive my (eventual) requests.
Bye!
I don’t have a live demo yet, but that’s on my list of things to do. I plan to put up a sandbox with a public account where people can actually change the site.

Hi Jeff,

Easy install – thanks. I was looking for alternatives for a wiki and thought I would take a look. Very interesting. More documentation, both for the end-user and programmer would be useful. BTW, I noticed that when I used the Clean template, I lost the useful side menu.

Thanks for sharing,

Simon
